PartialTerms.description:
Opt-in pro-rata settlement, agreed and signed by both parties inside the Contract.

When the buyer rejects a delivery whose evidence carries machine-checked counts
(`units_valid` of `units_total`), Trustee may capture `price * units_valid / units_total`
(rounded down to the cent) instead of voiding everything. It only does so when the valid
fraction is at least `min_fraction`; below that, the ordinary reject path applies.

min_fraction.description: Smallest valid fraction (0 < x <= 1) that still earns a pro-rata payment, e.g. 0.5.

info.description:
Trustee is an escrow and arbitration layer for agent-to-agent payments on PayPal. A buyer agent's funds are authorized (held), not captured, until the buyer attests that the seller's delivery matches the contract. Accept captures the funds to the seller. Reject opens a dispute that an arbiter rules on, and a ruling either captures or voids the hold. Dry-run mode (no PayPal credentials) keeps the same API surface.

## Signing scheme

Every mutating call is attributable to an Ed25519 key. Keys are 32-byte raw public keys, urlsafe-base64. Signed bytes are canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8; Decimals as strings, datetimes as ISO 8601) of the message without its signature field. Signatures are urlsafe-base64. A principal proves its key by signing {principal, public_key}; an agent proves possession by signing its registration body {agent_id, public_key, principal, roles (sorted), paypal_email} and is vouched for by the principal signing the same bytes; a mandate is signed by its principal over every field except principal_signature; a contract carries one signature per party over its sha256 digest; deliveries are signed by the seller and attestations by the buyer; an intent mandate is signed by its principal over every field except principal_signature, and funding requests by the principal. Settlement receipts are signed by Trustee (key at /.well-known/trustee-key.json). Operator endpoints use an HTTP bearer token.

post.description: The Agent2Agent protocol (spec 1.0.0, JSON-RPC binding) in front of the same service as `/v1`. Invoke a Trustee skill with `SendMessage` and one DataPart `{"skill": "<id>", "input": {...}}`; the input is the REST body of the matching `/v1` operation. A deal is a task whose id is the deal id; `GetTask` rebuilds it from the durable deal. Register a webhook with `CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig` (or `configuration.taskPushNotificationConfig` in `SendMessage`) to be told when funds are held or released. Signatures inside the payloads authorize every change; A2A is only the transport. Streaming is not supported. Skills and states are described in `docs/A2A.md` and the Agent Card.

post.description: `contract.signatures` must hold a valid Ed25519 signature by the buyer and by the seller over the contract digest (sha256 of the canonical terms, excluding `signatures` and `transcript_ref`). The mandate gate then checks the buyer's spending mandate and the seller's receiving mandate. Passing the gate opens an escrow: PayPal Orders v2 `AUTHORIZE`, so the buyer's funds are held and not captured. Returns 201 for a new deal. Repeating the identical contract returns 200 with the current view. A different contract under the same `deal_id` is a 409. A 502 means PayPal failed; the body includes the deal view, and retrying the same request is safe.

post.description: The seller sends the file's raw bytes (`application/octet-stream`) while funds are held, then records the delivery with that file's sha256 as `content_hash`. Trustee stores the file under its sha256, runs the contract's checks on it, and rules on its own result rather than on the buyer's report. The buyer gets the file from `GET` on the same path once the payment settles. Signed by the seller's agent key: `X-Trustee-Signature` is the signature over the UTF-8 bytes of `trustee-upload:{deal_id}:{sha256}`, where `{sha256}` is the lowercase hex sha256 of the request body. Only the seller's signed upload counts as the seller's file, so no one else can upload a file that makes the seller's delivery look false.
